John of Parma.fact: He assisted at the First Council of Lyons in 1245, representing the current Minister General, Crescentius of Jesi, who was too ill to attend.

John of Parma.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
John of Parma.question: Before departing, John appears to have held the _____ of Metz in 1249 (others put it after the embassy, 1251)
John of Parma.fact: Before departing, John appears to have held the General Chapter of Metz in 1249 (others put it after the embassy, 1251).

John of Parma.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
John of Parma.question: He obtained the permission of _____ to go to Greece, but reached only as far as Camerino, in the March of Ancona, where he died in the local friary on 19 March 1289
John of Parma.fact: He obtained the permission of Pope Nicolas IV to go to Greece, but reached only as far as Camerino, in the March of Ancona, where he died in the local friary on 19 March 1289.

John of Parma.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
John of Parma.question: He was beatified by _____ in 1777; his feast day is celebrated by the Friars Minor on 20 March
John of Parma.fact: He was beatified by Pope Pius VI in 1777; his feast day is celebrated by the Friars Minor on 20 March.
